environment.description: EKS pod running with default service account, PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with db_user having full SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on all tables including 'users' table with password hashes. Network policy allows unrestricted egress. The application is exposed via a basic nginx ingress controller with no request inspection, TLS termination only. RDS security group allows inbound from entire pod CIDR.

config.ingress: nginx-ingress-controller 1.9.4 with TLS termination, no ModSecurity, no annotation-based filtering
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15.4, db_user role has GRANT ALL on schema public
